name: NextEra Energy CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: NextEra Energy, Inc. is a North American company in electric power and energy infrastructure. Its subsidiaries include Florida Power & Light Company, a big U.S. electric utility, and NextEra Energy Resources, which produces large amounts of wind and solar power. Its electricity comes from nuclear, wind, solar and gas-fired plants and is generated, transmitted, distributed and sold by the group.
